findings.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
findings.review_comment: User-controlled username is directly interpolated into LDAP search filter without escaping special LDAP filter characters, creating an LDAP injection vulnerability. The code replaces {{username}} placeholders with raw input, allowing manipulation of the LDAP query structure. Implement proper LDAP filter escaping using functions like ldap.escapeFilter() before interpolation to neutralize special characters.

assessment.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: Username from external authentication request is directly interpolated into LDAP search filter template using string replacement without LDAP-specific escaping, then used in sensitive LDAP directory search operation

connection.evidence: username parameter flows from authenticate() function (external input) through _findUser() to searchFilter construction, then directly to self._adminClient.search() LDAP query

diff_causality.evidence: This line creates the vulnerable interpolation mechanism by replacing {{username}} placeholder with user input without proper escaping

security_control.evidence: Only basic empty username check exists; no LDAP-specific escaping or validation of special characters like parentheses, asterisks, or backslashes
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: LDAP filters use special characters (parentheses, asterisks, backslashes) that must be escaped to prevent injection attacks
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No escaping of LDAP special characters before interpolation into search filter template

concrete_impact.evidence: LDAP injection can bypass authentication, extract sensitive directory information, or modify directory data depending on LDAP server configuration

assessment.diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the searchFilter would not be constructed with user input, preventing the LDAP injection vulnerability at the interpolation point
supporting_evidence: Username parameter from external authenticate() function flows directly to search filter construction
LDAP search filter template uses {{username}} placeholder that gets replaced with raw user input
No LDAP-specific escaping or validation of special characters before interpolation
Resulting filter used in sensitive LDAP directory search operation
unresolved_facts: Whether ldapjs library performs any automatic escaping of LDAP filter special characters
Whether searchFilter configuration typically contains validation patterns
Whether there are external validation layers before authenticate() is called
